name: Pika Video Merge
description: Join videos into one clip: hand over two to ten in playback order and get back a single video with stereo audio, at the first clip's size and frame rate unless you choose a size, reference clip, or frame rate. Clips of a different shape get black bars. Billed per output second.

videos.description: Videos to join, 2–10, in playback order. Clips without audio play silence; the output has 48kHz stereo audio.
videos.title: Videos

target_fps.description: Output frame rate, 1–60. Defaults to the reference video's frame rate.
target_fps.title: Target Fps

resolution.description: Output size: a preset or an explicit {width, height} (even, 512–2048). Presets: square_hd 1024x1024, square 512x512, portrait_4_3 768x1024, portrait_16_9 576x1024, landscape_4_3 1024x768, landscape_16_9 1024x576. Omit it to use the size of the reference video (reference_video_index). Every clip is scaled to fit without distortion, with black bars filling any gap.
resolution.title: Resolution

reference_video_index.description: The video the output matches when resolution or target_fps is omitted, as an index into videos. Defaults to 0, the first video. Other clips are fit inside its size with black bars. Can't be combined with resolution.
reference_video_index.title: Reference Video Index
